state.objective: Lock the confirmed same-legal-entity HO-unit model and challenge a concrete target grouping for prepaid, tax, accrued expense and advances.
state.new_confirmed_fact: All HO and operating units/sites belong to one Indonesian PT Perorangan. The units are operating branches/sites of that same legal entity, not separate companies.
other_confirmed_facts: Finance and bank access are centralized at HO; units cannot transact directly with other units.
Site is already represented by site_id; no general counter_site_id or related_site_id is needed.
The 70 legacy affiliate receivable/payable families have three receivable natures and two payable natures, each repeated for 14 named HO/sites.
No balances or transaction history has been supplied, so legacy balances still require traceable reclassification and reconciliation before accounts are deactivated.
There are nine prepaid-expense, six prepaid-tax, five tax-payable, one unresolved Current Tax Inc/Exp PPh 25, ten accrued-expense and four advance families.
A controlled schedule can store type, counterparty/employee, document, dates, tax code/period, due date, settlement, site and cost center.

prepaid: General prepaid control: insurance, maintenance contract, promotion, business permit and other, subject to recognition/reporting alignment.
Rent/lease prepaid remains provisional until land/store/house/vehicle contracts and ROU policy are reviewed.
tax: Income-tax credits/installments provisional control: PPh 21/25/29 only if returns establish compatible asset treatment.
Input VAT remains separately controlled from output VAT.
PBB and Other Tax remain provisional pending return/recoverability review.
Five tax-payable families may become one Tax Payable control GL only if tax ledger and statutory reconciliation preserve each tax code and due date.
Current Tax Inc/Exp PPh 25 remains unmapped pending transaction analysis.
accrual: Employee/payroll accrual control: salary, THR/bonus/severance, medical and BPJS, provided statutory/disclosure detail remains in payroll/accrual schedules.
Loan-interest accrual control remains separate and linked to facility_id.
Operating accrual control: telephone, electricity and water with accrual_type/site detail.
Rent accrual control: store and house rent, subject to lease-policy review.
advances: Employee/travel advances remain distinguishable from supplier/contractor advances.
Purchase and contractor advances may share a Supplier/Contractor Advance control only if party, PO/contract, tax and settlement treatment align.
Other advances remain controlled and provisional.

interunit_zero_permanent.instructions: With one legal entity and centralized books, should the target COA contain permanent affiliate receivable/payable accounts between HO and its units?

criteria.no: Reclassify to underlying cash, inventory, expense or justified temporary clearing; deactivate all 70 legacy permanent affiliate accounts after reconciliation.
criteria.five: Keep five affiliate AR/AP natures between internal sites.

interunit_balance_action.instructions: What should happen to any nonzero balances in the 70 accounts?

criteria.trace_reclass: Match counterpart and source transactions, reclassify to underlying nature or justified clearing, reconcile, then deactivate.
criteria.delete: Delete them because all sites are one entity.

prepaid_general_group.instructions: Can insurance, maintenance contract, promotion, permit and other prepaids use one general prepaid control GL when schedules preserve type and recognition pattern?

criteria.conditional: Yes, if financial reporting, materiality and amortization reconciliation align.

prepaid_rent_group.instructions: After contracts confirm the same prepaid-expense treatment rather than ROU/land-right treatment, can land/store/house/vehicle rent prepaids use one prepaid-rent control GL with lease_type/object detail?

criteria.conditional: Yes, after contract and policy validation.
criteria.retain4: Object identity must always remain in GL.

income_tax_credit_group.instructions: Can PPh 21, PPh 25 and PPh 29 prepaid/credit balances share one Income Tax Credits GL if tax returns and ledger reconcile them by tax_code and period?

criteria.conditional: Possible subject to legal recoverability, classification and return reconciliation.
criteria.always_separate: Every PPh article must always be a GL.

input_vat_separate.instructions: Should Input VAT remain a separate tax-asset control from income-tax credits and Output VAT liability?

criteria.yes: Keep separately controlled; tax return settlement may later offset under applicable rules.
criteria.one_tax: Combine all tax assets and liabilities in one posting GL.

pbb_other_tax.instructions: Can prepaid PBB and Other Tax be assigned to the income-tax-credit or VAT controls from names alone?

criteria.no: Keep provisional until recoverability, return and nature are verified.

tax_payable_one.instructions: Can five tax-payable GLs become one Tax Payable control when a mandatory tax ledger preserves tax code, period, return, due date and payment reconciliation?

criteria.conditional: Yes, subject to statutory presentation and reliable reconciliation.

employee_accrual_one.instructions: Can four employee-related accruals become one Employee Benefits Accrued GL with payroll component detail?

criteria.conditional: Yes, if current/noncurrent, statutory, severance and disclosure distinctions remain reportable and reconciled.
criteria.merge_operating: Merge with utilities and rent immediately.

operating_accrual_one.instructions: Can telephone, electricity and water accruals use one Operating Utilities Accrued GL with accrual_type and site detail?

criteria.conditional: Yes, if vendor/subledger and management reporting reconcile.
criteria.expense: Post only to expense and omit liability.

rent_accrual_one.instructions: Can store and house rent accruals use one Rent Accrued GL after lease-policy validation?

criteria.conditional: Yes, with lease/object detail and reconciliation.

interest_accrual_separate.instructions: Should accrued loan interest remain a separate financing liability linked to facility_id rather than merge into operating accruals?

criteria.yes: Keep a separate accrued-interest natural account.

advances_two_plus_other.instructions: Is a provisional structure of Employee/Travel Advances, Supplier/Contractor Advances, and Other Advances more defensible than one unrestricted advance GL?

criteria.yes: Use three controls with party/purpose/aging details; consider further merge only after evidence.
criteria.four: Purpose labels must always stay as four GLs.

safe_count_basis.instructions: May the proposed group counts be treated as final before schedules, tax returns, contracts and balances are reconciled?

criteria.no: They are conditional target groups only.
criteria.yes: Approve from Jev answers and names.

next_domain.instructions: After schedules and tax, which remaining identity-heavy domain should be reviewed next?

criteria.ar_ap_party: Customer/supplier identities in receivables and payables.
